review_evidence: All four primary files were inspected and contain active formal declarations.

Mathlib/Units.lean/unitmk.lean defines number-field polynomials, irreducibility/integrality lemmas, arithmetic invariants and a fundamental unit; the three Spec files define orbit relations, opaque wanted predicates, specification structures, and `sorry`-bearing existence/uniqueness theorem targets.
These `sorry` specification statements are precisely useful prior-art/definition targets and are retained.
summary: Reviewed LeanBridge mathematical/specification subtrees and retain all four files as substantive formal content.

review_evidence: grep -c -E '\b(theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom)\b' over the four files gave Basic.lean=47, Demo.lean=14, Lookup.lean=16, Tables.lean=12 matches, all well above zero.

Read LeanBridge/Lookup/Basic.lean completely: it defines the `Cmp` inductive, `Column`/`Cond`/`TableInfo` structures, and ~25 def-level recognizer combinators used to translate Lean expressions into SQL fragments — genuine formal-metaprogramming content, not junk or a stub.

Read LeanBridge/Lookup/Lookup.lean completely: it defines the `lookup` tactic via `elab "lookup" : tactic`, with supporting defs for SQL query construction, hypothesis collection (`collectHypotheses`), and HTML/text reporting.

Read LeanBridge/Lookup/Tables.lean completely: it defines four `TableInfo` values (`nfFields`, `ecCurvedata`, `gpsGroups`, `mfNewspaces`) wiring named Mathlib constants (e.g. `NumberField.classNumber`, `WeierstrassCurve.j`, `Group.IsNilpotent`) to LMFDB SQL columns.

Read LeanBridge/Lookup/Demo.lean completely: it contains 11 `example` theorems over number fields, elliptic curves (`WeierstrassCurve.Affine`), a simple group, and a modular form space, each closed by the `lookup` tactic — genuine proof-adjacent content exercising the tactic.
summary: Read all four files of the unit in full. LeanBridge/Lookup/Basic.lean (358 lines) defines the Cmp inductive, Column/Cond structures, and recognizer combinators (headIs, finrankOver, cardMentions, isoStructure, etc.) plus TableInfo. LeanBridge/Lookup/Lookup.lean (213 lines) defines the `lookup` elaborated tactic, its SQL translation (toCond, toSqlCondCmp, buildQuery) and reporting. LeanBridge/Lookup/Tables.lean (168 lines) registers four LMFDB TableInfo instances (nf_fields, ec_curvedata, gps_groups, mf_newspaces) with their recognisers. LeanBridge/Lookup/Demo.lean (74 lines) is a sequence of `example` theorems exercised by the `lookup` tactic over number fields, elliptic curves, finite groups, and modular forms. All four are substantive Lean source with declarations, structures, and proofs/examples; none is empty, generated, or non-mathematical. Matches the disposition of the prior review RRV-9461c60db37d-r1.
